experience.title: Moonray PBC
experience.description: Principal Sound Designer, Audio Producer, Technical Sound Designer, Audio Developer, Music Composer
highlights: Sole Audio Designer responsible for every aspect of the project's audio, from composition and sound design to technical implementation, optimization, voice direction, and production.

Owned the complete audio production pipeline as the sole Audio Designer, delivering 1,000+ sound assets, interactive music, voice-over, implementation, optimization, and final mix for the entire project.
Designed and implemented 10+ gameplay audio systems in Wwise and Unreal Engine 5, including interactive music, footsteps, UI, announcer, HDR mixing, and dynamic audio behaviors using Blueprints.
Composed six adaptive music tracks and developed a Blueprint-driven interactive music system supporting multiple gameplay states and game modes.
Produced sound design and music for 12 cinematic marketing videos and character reveals.
Directed remote voice-over sessions for four professional voice actors and implemented voice systems for in-game announcer and God voice events.
Served as Principal Audio Designer, defining audio standards, documentation, workflows, naming conventions, implementation guidelines, and final creative direction across the project.
Designed the project's audio architecture, including RTPCs, States, Switches, Events, SoundBanks, audio buses, profiling, memory optimization, and platform-specific audio optimization.
Created audio for multiple melee combat systems, ranged weapons, UI, character movement, voice reactions, marketing trailers, and gameplay feedback across PC, Android, PlayStation 5, and iOS.
